top.name: Contingency
top.rules_text: Choose one — prepare a Snare glyph on the target tile, or trigger all of your prepared glyphs.

options.label: Lay the Snare
options.description: Prepare a glyph here. When an enemy enters: 4 damage and rooted for 1 turn.

options.label: Spring the Web
options.description: Trigger all of your prepared glyphs, +1 damage per other glyph triggered.

bottom.name: Read the Weave
bottom.rules_text: Look at the top 2 cards. Put 1 back on top, bottom the other. Gain 1 Weave.

upgrades.description: The snare bites harder; the weave banks more.
